reference.code: pub fn shard_routing(s:&str)->Option<String>{let p:Vec<_>=s.split(';').collect();if p.len()!=2||p[1].is_empty(){return None}let n:usize=p[0].parse().ok()?;if n<1||n>1024||n.to_string()!=p[0]{return None}let mut o=vec![];for k in p[1].split(','){if k.is_empty()||!k.bytes().all(|c|(32..=126).contains(&c)&&c!=b','&&c!=b';'){return None}o.push(format!("{}={}",k,k.bytes().map(|x|x as usize).sum::<usize>()%n))}Some(o.join(","))}
